rationale.consistency: Perfectly matches Go idioms, CLI structure, and the zoekt code style.
rationale.edge_cases: Gracefully handles root-as-repository, duplicate names, dry-run safety, and compound shards during pruning.
rationale.scope: Implements exactly the requested commands and functionality with no unrelated changes.
rationale.readability: Clean, well-documented code with excellently named functions and logical separation of concerns.
rationale.robustness: Uses robust locking, safely handles metadata read failures, and prevents deleting compound shards containing active repositories.
rationale.maintainability: Modular design with independent discovery, index management, and CLI layers makes it highly extensible.
